sources.description: Saquon Barkley will not be traded before the trade deadline, sources told NFL Network, putting an end to speculation that the Eagles RB could be on the move.

sources.name: NFL.com
sources.headline: NFL Network: Eagles won't trade RB Saquon Barkley ahead of Nov. 10 deadline
sources.description: If GM Howie Roseman is willing to wheel and deal in the coming weeks, at least one major name won't be on the move. The Eagles will not be trading former Offensive Player of the Year Saquon Barkley.

sources.headline: Eagles reportedly won't trade Saquon Barkley
sources.description: At a time when some believe the Eagles are in a soft tank, their subtle effort to secure better round-by-round draft position in 2027 won't include getting an extra draft pick or two for running back Saquon Barkley.

sources.description: A report before Sunday's games said that the Eagles will not trade running back Saquon Barkley ahead of the November 10 trade deadline and Barkley said after Sunday night's game against the Commanders that he's received the same message from the team.
